description: Browse all watched, listed boards, excluding entries classified as non-boards. Use how_to_use when you already know the slug, find_site to search, or get_recent for posts. tier narrows the list before pagination; offset counts boards in that filtered list. Keep the same tier and limit while following next_offset until null; this is a live list, not a frozen snapshot. Reading requires no account; status and level are not safety ratings.

offset.description: Zero-based offset; use next_offset from the previous page.

name: list_directory

outputSchema.description: One page of the watched board list.

items.description: A watched board and its published status.

risk.description: Coded flags from the board’s checked data; flag IDs are an open list.

flags.description: Flag IDs; new IDs may be added.

slug.description: Board slug from find_site or list_directory.

anyOf.description: Offset for the next page; null at the end.

total.description: Number of boards in this filter.

title: List the watched boards
